description: This file contains unit tests for the FileBasedRegistrationService class, focusing on file persistence, startup behavior, device management limits, and configuration enforcement within the context of device registration in the Eclipse Hono project.

classes.name: FileBasedRegistrationServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for verifying the functionality of FileBasedRegistrationService, including file operations, startup behavior, and device registry limits within the Eclipse Hono framework.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes mock components and the registration service before each test.

methods.name: getRegistrationService
methods.description: Returns the registration service instance used for testing.

methods.name: getDeviceManagementService
methods.description: Returns the device management service instance used for testing.

methods.name: testSaveToFileCreatesFile
methods.description: Verifies that the registration service creates a file if it does not exist when saving data.

methods.name: testDoStartCreatesFile
methods.description: Verifies that the service creates the persistence file during startup if it does not exist.

methods.name: testDoStartFailsIfFileCannotBeCreated
methods.description: Ensures startup fails gracefully if the persistence file cannot be created.

methods.name: testDoStartIgnoresMalformedJson
methods.description: Checks that startup succeeds even if the file contains malformed JSON.

methods.name: testDoStartLoadsDeviceIdentities
methods.description: Verifies that device identities are loaded from the file at startup.

methods.name: testLoadDevicesCanReadOutputOfSaveToFile
methods.description: Ensures the registry can serialize to and load from the persistent file correctly.

methods.name: testDoStartIgnoreIdentitiesIfStartEmptyIsSet
methods.description: Checks that device identities are ignored if startEmpty is configured during startup.

methods.name: testAddDeviceFailsIfDeviceLimitIsReached
methods.description: Verifies enforcement of maximum device per tenant limit.

methods.name: testUpdateDeviceFailsIfModificationIsDisabled
methods.description: Ensures devices cannot be updated when modification is disabled.

methods.name: testRemoveDeviceFailsIfModificationIsDisabled
methods.description: Ensures devices cannot be removed when modification is disabled.

methods.name: testPeriodicSafeJobIsNotScheduledIfSavingIfDisabled
methods.description: Verifies that no periodic save task is scheduled when saveToFile is disabled.

methods.name: testContentsNotSavedOnShutdownIfSavingIfDisabled
methods.description: Checks that no data is persisted upon shutdown if saving is disabled.
